basis: Reconciled against Certificate of Waiver and Authorization 107W-2026-01762 as issued, effective 13 AUG 2026 to 31 JAN 2030, which supersedes 107W-2025-04534. Version 3.0 restates the shielded/non-shielded split (SP 11/SP 12), the three operations-over-non-participants pathways (SP 13/SP 14/SP 15), the SP 16 UASFM authorization and NOTAM requirement, and the EP operating interpretations documented under interpretations in this file. Items carried over from the superseded certificate as EP practice are labelled as such.

rules.label: Site name or ID
rules.failReason: Site name or ID is required before approval.
rules.correctiveAction: Enter a unique site name or identifier.

rules.label: Site location
rules.failReason: Site address or coordinates are required before approval.
rules.correctiveAction: Enter an address or capture site coordinates.

rules.label: Assessment date
rules.failReason: Assessment date is required before approval.
rules.correctiveAction: Enter the assessment date.

rules.label: Assessed by
rules.failReason: Assessor name is required before approval.
rules.correctiveAction: Enter who completed the assessment.

rules.label: RPIC reviewing
rules.failReason: RPIC review entry is required before approval.
rules.correctiveAction: Enter the reviewing RPIC.

rules.label: Launch method
rules.failReason: Launch method is required before approval.
rules.correctiveAction: Select tactical, dock, or both.

rules.label: Maximum takeoff weight recorded
rules.failReason: Aircraft maximum takeoff weight has not been recorded.
rules.correctiveAction: Record maximum takeoff weight including all attachments. Weight selects the operations-over-non-participants pathway (SP 13, SP 14 or SP 15).

rules.label: Weight within SP 13 ceiling
rules.failReason: Maximum takeoff weight exceeds 8.8 lb (4.0 kg), the ceiling for non-PRS operations over non-participants.
rules.correctiveAction: Use an aircraft at or below 8.8 lb, fit a conforming PRS (SP 14, 10 lb ceiling), or plan the route to avoid overflight of non-participants and moving vehicles.

rules.label: Weight within SP 14 ceiling
rules.failReason: Maximum takeoff weight exceeds 10 lb, the ceiling for PRS-equipped operations over non-participants.
rules.correctiveAction: Use an aircraft at or below 10 lb, or plan the route to avoid overflight of non-participants and moving vehicles.

rules.label: PRS minimum deployment height recorded
rules.failReason: PRS manufacturer minimum deployment height has not been recorded.
rules.correctiveAction: Record the minimum deployment height from the PRS operator manual. The aircraft may not be operated lower than it.

rules.label: Rotating component shielding fitted
rules.failReason: Prop guards or an equivalent laceration-prevention system have not been verified for the SP 15 pathway.
rules.correctiveAction: Verify prop guards or a laceration-prevention system are fitted. Weight including all attachments must remain at or below 0.88 lb.

rules.label: Anti-collision lighting
rules.failReason: Anti-collision lighting has not been verified operational.
rules.correctiveAction: Verify 107.29-compliant anti-collision lighting is fitted and operational at all times.

rules.label: ADS-B In operational
rules.failReason: ADS-B In receiver has not been verified operational and monitored.
rules.correctiveAction: Verify an ADS-B In receiver is operational and monitored. A phone or third-party internet service does not satisfy this.

rules.label: ADS-B Out not transmitting
rules.failReason: ADS-B Out has not been confirmed as not transmitting.
rules.correctiveAction: Confirm ADS-B Out (1090/978 MHz) is not transmitting.

rules.label: Standard remote identification
rules.failReason: Standard remote ID compliance has not been verified.
rules.correctiveAction: Verify the aircraft is a standard remote identification aircraft on the FAA declaration of compliance list.

rules.label: Flight termination system
rules.failReason: Independent flight termination system has not been verified for multi-aircraft operations.
rules.correctiveAction: Verify each aircraft has an independent FTS and that FTS and geofencing are verified operational before each flight.

rules.label: GCS telemetry display
rules.failReason: Required GCS telemetry display items have not been verified.
rules.correctiveAction: Verify the GCS displays altitude, position, direction of flight, ground speed, C2 signal strength, navigation signal condition, battery condition, and distance from the control station.

rules.label: Maintenance log current
rules.failReason: Maintenance log has not been reviewed.
rules.correctiveAction: Review the maintenance log for each aircraft before operations.

rules.label: Emitter FCC compliance
rules.failReason: Emitter FCC compliance has not been confirmed.
rules.correctiveAction: Confirm all emitters comply with their FCC authorization. An FCC Experimental authorization may not be used.

rules.label: PRS 7-day defect verification
rules.failReason: Verification that the PRS has no known safety defects within the previous 7 calendar days has not been recorded.
rules.correctiveAction: Responsible Person and RPIC verify the PRS has no known safety defects within the 7 calendar days before operations, and record it.

rules.label: PRS unmodified and repacked
rules.failReason: PRS modification status and repack status after any deployment have not been confirmed.
rules.correctiveAction: Confirm no modification to the PRS, identical replacement parts only, and manufacturer repack after any deployment.

rules.label: sUAS design unmodified
rules.failReason: Confirmation that the sUAS design is unmodified has not been recorded.
rules.correctiveAction: Confirm no modification to the sUAS design. Repairs use identical replacement parts only.

rules.label: Functional test flight after maintenance
rules.failReason: Post-maintenance functional test flight status has not been confirmed.
rules.correctiveAction: Confirm any aircraft that underwent maintenance completed a logged functional test flight under standard Part 107 before waivered operations.

rules.label: Multi-UAS make, model and FMS as specified
rules.failReason: Multi-aircraft operations have not been confirmed to use the make/model and Flight Management System specified in the waiver application.
rules.correctiveAction: Confirm the aircraft and FMS match the waiver application for multi-UAS operations, or operate a single aircraft.

rules.label: No more than six aircraft
rules.failReason: More than six aircraft are planned for simultaneous operation.
rules.correctiveAction: Reduce simultaneous aircraft to six or fewer.

rules.label: Aircraft on eligible-UAS list
rules.failReason: Aircraft has not been confirmed on the Responsible Person eligible-UAS list.
rules.correctiveAction: Confirm the make and model appears on the eligible-UAS list with date added and affirming person.

rules.label: Obstruction continuity recorded
rules.failReason: Obstruction continuity has not been recorded.
rules.correctiveAction: Record whether obstruction is continuous, present with gaps, or absent along the entire route. This selects SP 11 (shielded) or SP 12 (non-shielded).

rules.label: DAA status recorded
rules.failReason: DAA status at this site has not been recorded.
rules.correctiveAction: Record whether DAA is unused, active and observed, or installed with compromised coverage.

rules.label: Non-shielded mitigation present
rules.failReason: Non-shielded with neither DAA nor a Visual Observer. SP 12 offers two alternatives, DAA or VO(s). With neither, this is not an operation under this waiver.
rules.correctiveAction: Conduct the flight under standard Part 107 within visual line of sight, reclassify as SP 11 shielded, assign VO(s) sufficient for a 2 SM radius, or use the DAA system described in the waiver application.

rules.label: Shielding gaps documented
rules.failReason: Shielding gaps have not been identified and documented.
rules.correctiveAction: Identify every segment that reclassifies to SP 12 and document it. The certificate provides no partial-shielding allowance.

rules.label: Open-air assembly exposure recorded
rules.failReason: Whether an open-air assembly of persons is present in the operational area has not been recorded.
rules.correctiveAction: Record whether any open-air assembly of persons is within or adjacent to the planned route.

rules.label: No open-air assembly overflight
rules.failReason: Operations over open-air assemblies of persons are prohibited under every pathway of this certificate. There is no coordination alternative.
rules.correctiveAction: Exclude the assembly from the operational area and route, or do not fly under this waiver while it is present.

rules.label: No sustained operations over non-participants or vehicles
rules.failReason: Sustained operations over non-participants or moving vehicles (loitering, hovering, continuous or sequential overflight) are prohibited under every pathway. The closed-site exception in the superseded certificate no longer exists.
rules.correctiveAction: Redesign the route so overflight is transitory only, or remove overflight from the plan.

rules.label: UASFM operation status recorded
rules.failReason: Whether the site relies on the SP 16 §107.41 authorization (at or below UASFM grid altitudes) has not been recorded.
rules.correctiveAction: Record whether operations at this site rely on SP 16.

rules.label: Direct voice with every VO
rules.failReason: Direct voice communication with every VO has not been confirmed.
rules.correctiveAction: Confirm continuous full-duplex, hands-free voice with each VO and a reliable backup. Operations cease if voice is lost (SP 21(c)).

rules.label: VO count sufficient for 2 SM
rules.failReason: VO coverage of a 2 statute mile radius has not been confirmed. This is the definition of sufficient VO(s) under SP 12(c).
rules.correctiveAction: Confirm the number of VOs continuously observes at least a 2 SM radius around the aircraft, or add VOs.

rules.label: VO training documented
rules.failReason: Documented VO training (operational volume scanning, communications and phraseology, overall waiver operations) has not been confirmed.
rules.correctiveAction: Confirm each VO has documented training for the SP 12(f) items.

rules.label: Restricted access site
rules.failReason: Operations over non-participants with an aircraft over 0.88 lb and no PRS require a site restricted from the general public, with persons present related to the site.
rules.correctiveAction: Restrict site access to the general public, fit a conforming PRS (SP 14), use an aircraft at or below 0.88 lb (SP 15), or plan the route to avoid overflight.

rules.label: Persons on site equipped with PPE
rules.failReason: Persons in the operational area have not been confirmed as site-related and equipped with appropriate PPE (hard hats, gloves, work boots or similar).
rules.correctiveAction: Confirm the client will require PPE for persons in the operational area during operations, or use the SP 14 or SP 15 pathway.

rules.label: Authorized persons notified
rules.failReason: Notification of all persons authorized inside the operational area has not been addressed.
rules.correctiveAction: Confirm every person authorized inside the operational area will be notified of UAS operations.

rules.label: Routes designed to avoid overflight
rules.failReason: Flight paths and routes have not been confirmed as designed to avoid overflight of human beings and traffic areas.
rules.correctiveAction: Design and document routes that avoid overflight of human beings and traffic areas. Any overflight must be transitory.

rules.label: PRS operational and ASTM F3322-18
rules.failReason: PRS has not been confirmed operational and compliant with ASTM F3322-18 as revised.
rules.correctiveAction: Confirm PRS conformance and operational status before flight.

rules.label: Planned altitude at or above PRS minimum
rules.failReason: Planned altitude is below the PRS manufacturer minimum deployment height.
rules.correctiveAction: Raise the planned altitude to at least the PRS minimum deployment height, or use another pathway.

rules.label: PRS floor recorded
rules.failReason: Minimum altitude floor for overflight has not been recorded.
rules.correctiveAction: Record the PRS minimum deployment height as the floor for this site.

rules.label: Airspace classification confirmed
rules.failReason: Airspace classification has not been confirmed.
rules.correctiveAction: Confirm and document the airspace class at the site.

rules.label: Airspace authorization basis confirmed
rules.failReason: Airspace authorization basis has not been confirmed.
rules.correctiveAction: Class G: none required. Controlled airspace at or below the UASFM grid: SP 16 authorizes it with a NOTAM. Above the grid or grid zero: separate ATC authorization; LAANC may not be used for waivered operations.

rules.label: UASFM grid ceiling recorded
rules.failReason: The UASFM grid altitude at this site has not been recorded. SP 11(c) makes it the controlling altitude and SP 16 limits the authorization to it.
rules.correctiveAction: Record the published UASFM grid altitude for the site.

rules.label: NOTAM procedure assigned
rules.failReason: The NOTAM filing procedure for SP 16 operations has not been assigned.
rules.correctiveAction: Assign responsibility to file a NOTAM no more than 72 and no less than 24 hours before operations, and to verify it is issued before flight.

rules.label: Planned altitude within UASFM grid
rules.failReason: Planned altitude exceeds the UASFM grid altitude. SP 16 authorizes operations only at or below it.
rules.correctiveAction: Lower the planned altitude to the grid altitude or obtain a separate ATC authorization.

rules.label: Facilities within 3 miles identified
rules.failReason: Airports, heliports, known agricultural aerial application operations and aerial military installations within a 3 mile radius have not been identified.
rules.correctiveAction: Identify every such facility within a 3 mile radius. The provision states 3 miles, not 3 nautical miles.

rules.label: 3 mile notifications sent
rules.failReason: Documented notification to facilities within the 3 mile radius has not been completed.
rules.correctiveAction: Send and document notification to each facility identified.

rules.label: Low-level operations within 1 SM identified
rules.failReason: Areas or routes of low-level helicopter and airplane operations within one statute mile have not been identified.
rules.correctiveAction: Identify helipads, grass airstrips, airports, MOAs below 500 ft AGL, tour operators, and agricultural airstrips within 1 SM. Retained as EP practice; not stated in 107W-2026-01762.

rules.label: TFRs reviewed
rules.failReason: TFR review has not been completed.
rules.correctiveAction: Review TFR activity and document no operational conflict.

rules.label: NOTAMs reviewed
rules.failReason: NOTAM review has not been completed.
rules.correctiveAction: Review NOTAMs and document no operational conflict.

rules.label: Special use airspace cleared
rules.failReason: Restricted, prohibited, or special use airspace conflict has not been cleared.
rules.correctiveAction: Resolve the conflict or mark the site not approved.

rules.label: Waiver not combined
rules.failReason: Confirmation that this waiver is not combined with another authorization has not been recorded.
rules.correctiveAction: Confirm no other waiver, authorization, or exemption is being combined without specific FAA authorization.

rules.label: Property boundaries confirmed
rules.failReason: Property boundaries have not been confirmed.
rules.correctiveAction: Confirm boundaries by survey, plat, or client record.

rules.label: Controlled access verified
rules.failReason: Controlled access has not been verified.
rules.correctiveAction: Verify gates, fencing, or equivalent access controls.

rules.label: Non-participant notification
rules.failReason: Notification of non-participants inside the operational area has not been addressed.
rules.correctiveAction: Confirm non-participants will be notified of operations. Mandatory under SP 13(b) on that pathway; EP practice otherwise.

rules.label: Direct participants identifiable
rules.failReason: Direct participant identification has not been addressed.
rules.correctiveAction: Confirm direct participants are visually identifiable by apparel or safety vests. Retained as EP practice; not stated in 107W-2026-01762.

rules.label: Open-air assembly excluded
rules.failReason: Exclusion of open-air assemblies of persons from the operational area has not been confirmed.
rules.correctiveAction: Confirm no open-air assembly of persons is within the operational area, or that the route excludes it.

rules.label: Client point of contact
rules.failReason: Client point of contact has not been identified.
rules.correctiveAction: Identify and record the client POC.

rules.label: PPE arrangements confirmed on site
rules.failReason: PPE arrangements for persons in the operational area have not been confirmed.
rules.correctiveAction: Confirm with the client that persons in the operational area are site-related and equipped with appropriate PPE.

rules.label: Obstruction features identified
rules.failReason: Obstruction features have not been identified and photographed.
rules.correctiveAction: Identify and photograph the obstruction features relied on.

rules.label: Obstruction qualifies
rules.failReason: Obstruction qualification has not been confirmed.
rules.correctiveAction: Confirm each obstruction is a physical object, natural or man-made, that would stop or impede the aircraft on contact.

rules.label: Obstruction heights verified
rules.failReason: Obstruction heights have not been measured or verified.
rules.correctiveAction: Measure or verify heights. Estimated heights are not sufficient.

rules.label: Computed maximum altitude recorded
rules.failReason: Computed maximum altitude for this site has not been recorded.
rules.correctiveAction: Record the computed maximum AGL and brief it to the crew.

rules.label: 100 ft lateral radius confirmed
rules.failReason: The 100 ft lateral radius from the controlling obstruction has not been confirmed along the route.
rules.correctiveAction: Confirm the aircraft remains within 100 ft laterally of a qualifying obstruction wherever it relies on SP 11(b) above 200 ft AGL.

rules.label: Continuity confirmed
rules.failReason: Obstruction continuity has not been confirmed along the entire route.
rules.correctiveAction: Confirm continuity through climb, cruise, and descent.

rules.label: RTH inside shielding
rules.failReason: The RTH path has not been confirmed inside the shielding geometry.
rules.correctiveAction: Validate the RTH path against the shielding geometry.

rules.label: Within defined operational area
rules.failReason: Confinement to the defined operational area has not been confirmed.
rules.correctiveAction: Confirm the aircraft remains within the operational area defined by the CONOPS site selection performance procedures.

rules.label: UASFM grid height applied to shielded altitude
rules.failReason: Precedence of the UASFM grid height over the computed shielded altitude has not been confirmed.
rules.correctiveAction: Confirm the computed altitude does not exceed the published UASFM grid height at the site, or that the site is outside a UASFM grid.

rules.label: Shielded altitude within UASFM grid
rules.failReason: Computed shielded altitude exceeds the UASFM grid height, which takes precedence under SP 11(c).
rules.correctiveAction: Cap the shielded altitude at the grid height.

rules.label: Launch and recovery areas designated
rules.failReason: Launch and recovery areas have not been pre-designated.
rules.correctiveAction: Pre-designate and document launch and recovery areas.

rules.label: Launch area monitored
rules.failReason: Monitoring of launch and recovery areas has not been addressed.
rules.correctiveAction: Confirm the areas will be monitored to keep non-participants out before, during, and immediately after flight.

rules.label: Emergency landing zones identified
rules.failReason: Emergency landing zones have not been identified.
rules.correctiveAction: Identify emergency landing zones inside containment.

rules.label: Overhead hazards cleared
rules.failReason: Overhead hazards at launch and landing have not been cleared.
rules.correctiveAction: Confirm no power lines, cranes, or lifts over the launch or landing area.

rules.label: Pedestrian and vehicle traffic documented
rules.failReason: Pedestrian and vehicular traffic in the immediate vicinity has not been documented.
rules.correctiveAction: Document traffic patterns for business hours and off hours. Retained as EP practice; not stated in 107W-2026-01762.

rules.label: Ground risk mitigations documented
rules.failReason: Ground risk mitigations have not been documented.
rules.correctiveAction: Document altitude, time of day, corridor avoidance, or other mitigations.

rules.label: Illumination or daytime assessment
rules.failReason: Neither a daytime site assessment nor sufficient illumination has been recorded.
rules.correctiveAction: Record that the assessment was conducted in daylight, or that the area is sufficiently illuminated. Retained as EP practice; not stated in 107W-2026-01762.

rules.label: Dock evaluated for remote condition check
rules.failReason: Dock evaluation under §107.15 and §107.49 has not been confirmed.
rules.correctiveAction: Confirm the dock lets the RPIC determine the aircraft is safe for flight, clear the immediate flight area, and assess weather at the dock from the remote location.

rules.label: Every segment designated
rules.failReason: One or more route segments have no C2 designation.
rules.correctiveAction: Assign Green, Yellow, or Red to every route segment.

rules.label: No red segments
rules.failReason: One or more route segments are designated Red. C2 signal strength is not sufficient for control through the entire route.
rules.correctiveAction: Revalidate the affected segments or remove them from the route. Red segments are not authorized.

rules.label: Yellow segments carry a restriction
rules.failReason: A segment is designated Yellow with no operating restriction recorded.
rules.correctiveAction: Record the operating restriction for each Yellow segment and carry it into the approval conditions.

rules.label: C2 validated through entire route
rules.failReason: C2 signal strength has not been validated as sufficient for control through the entire route.
rules.correctiveAction: Complete C2 validation per Appendix C.6.

rules.label: Cellular voice crew link tested
rules.failReason: The cellular voice crew link has not been tested end to end at this site.
rules.correctiveAction: Test the primary full-duplex, hands-free crew link at the site. Data coverage does not establish voice link performance.

rules.label: Backup crew link tested
rules.failReason: The backup crew communication method has not been tested at this site.
rules.correctiveAction: Test the backup crew link. SP 12(e)(iii) requires a reliable backup where VO communication is by electronic device.

rules.label: Cease-on-loss briefed
rules.failReason: The crew has not been briefed that operations cease if full-duplex voice with any VO is lost.
rules.correctiveAction: Brief the cease-on-loss requirement to the entire crew.

rules.label: RPIC within the continental United States
rules.failReason: Location of the RPIC within the continental United States has not been confirmed.
rules.correctiveAction: Confirm the RPIC will operate from a location within the continental United States.

rules.label: ADS-B In reception at site
rules.failReason: ADS-B In reception has not been confirmed adequate at this site.
rules.correctiveAction: Confirm ADS-B In reception at the operating location.

rules.label: DAA active and under observation
rules.failReason: DAA active status and observation by the RPIC or Electronic Observer have not been confirmed.
rules.correctiveAction: Confirm the DAA system described in the waiver application is active and under observation during all operations at this site.

rules.label: Obstacles and boundaries identified
rules.failReason: Flight area obstacles and boundaries have not been identified.
rules.correctiveAction: Identify obstacles and boundaries to avoid collision with or damage to property.

rules.label: Highest obstacle recorded
rules.failReason: The highest obstacle between takeoff and any point along the route has not been recorded.
rules.correctiveAction: Record the highest obstacle height for RTH altitude planning. Retained as EP practice; not stated in 107W-2026-01762.

rules.label: Wires and cables evaluated
rules.failReason: Wires and cables have not been evaluated.
rules.correctiveAction: Evaluate power, communications, and trolley cables near the route.

rules.label: Geofence contains operational volume
rules.failReason: Geofence coverage has not been confirmed.
rules.correctiveAction: Set the geofence to confine all aircraft to the operational volume.

rules.label: Geofence matches perimeter and altitude
rules.failReason: Geofence alignment to property or access perimeter and maximum altitude has not been confirmed.
rules.correctiveAction: Align the geofence to the perimeter plus the maximum allowed altitude.

rules.label: RTH altitude programmed
rules.failReason: RTH altitude has not been confirmed to clear obstructions and stay at or below 400 ft AGL.
rules.correctiveAction: Program RTH altitude to clear obstructions along the RTH route without exceeding 400 ft AGL. Retained as EP practice; the 5 second trigger and RTH altitude language of the superseded certificate are not in 107W-2026-01762.

rules.label: RTH trigger configured
rules.failReason: RTH trigger on signal loss has not been confirmed.
rules.correctiveAction: Confirm the RTH trigger on link loss matches the loss of C2 procedure in the waiver application. Retained as EP practice.

rules.label: RTH stays inside volume
rules.failReason: RTH deviation outside the operational volume has not been ruled out.
rules.correctiveAction: Configure RTH so it cannot deviate from the defined operational volume.

rules.label: Link reestablishment route defined
rules.failReason: A predetermined route to reestablish command and control has not been defined.
rules.correctiveAction: Define the predetermined C2 reestablishment route and the loss of C2 procedure described in the waiver application.

rules.label: Conformance monitoring functional
rules.failReason: Conformance monitoring and alerts have not been confirmed functional.
rules.correctiveAction: Verify geofence loss-of-containment and intrusion alerting.

rules.label: Routes preplanned with waypoints
rules.failReason: Routes have not been preplanned with waypoints.
rules.correctiveAction: Program waypoint-based routes the aircraft follows automatically. Manual flight is allowed as necessary.

rules.label: Route within containment
rules.failReason: The entire route has not been validated inside containment.
rules.correctiveAction: Validate route containment or revise the route.

rules.label: Planned altitude documented
rules.failReason: Planned altitude has not been documented.
rules.correctiveAction: Record planned altitude in feet AGL and compare against the computed ceiling.

rules.label: Planned altitude within computed ceiling
rules.failReason: Planned altitude exceeds the computed maximum altitude recorded for this site.
rules.correctiveAction: Lower the planned altitude or re-verify the computed ceiling.

rules.label: Emergency routes validated
rules.failReason: Emergency descent and landing routes have not been validated.
rules.correctiveAction: Validate emergency descent and landing routes.

rules.label: Simulation testing completed
rules.failReason: Simulation-based testing has not been completed.
rules.correctiveAction: Complete simulation-based testing as described in the waiver application. Retained as EP practice.

rules.label: Planned altitude at or below 400 ft AGL
rules.failReason: Planned altitude exceeds 400 ft AGL. Nothing in this certificate waives 107.51(b).
rules.correctiveAction: Lower the planned altitude to 400 ft AGL or less.

rules.label: Flight Risk Assessment completed
rules.failReason: Flight Risk Assessment is not documented.
rules.correctiveAction: Complete and document the Flight Risk Assessment.

rules.label: Pre-flight hazard checklist
rules.failReason: Pre-flight hazard checklist has not been prepared and briefed.
rules.correctiveAction: Prepare the checklist and brief it to the VOs and the person flying the aircraft. Retained as EP practice.

rules.label: Safety review completed
rules.failReason: Required safety review items have not been addressed.
rules.correctiveAction: Address all SP 23 safety review items.

rules.label: Waiver available at GCS
rules.failReason: Availability of the waiver and application at the ground control station has not been confirmed.
rules.correctiveAction: Confirm a copy is available to the RPIC at the GCS.

rules.label: Operations manual available
rules.failReason: Availability of the current operations manual has not been confirmed.
rules.correctiveAction: Confirm the manual is available to the RPIC and all direct participants.

rules.label: Site meets selection criteria
rules.failReason: Conformity to the site selection performance procedures has not been confirmed.
rules.correctiveAction: Confirm the site meets the site selection performance procedures in the waiver application.

rules.label: Overall risk level assigned
rules.failReason: Overall site risk level has not been assigned.
rules.correctiveAction: Assign low, medium, or high overall site risk.

rules.label: Risk mitigations documented
rules.failReason: Risk mitigations have not been documented.
rules.correctiveAction: Document the mitigations relied on.

rules.label: Unresolved risks flagged
rules.failReason: Unresolved risks have not been documented.
rules.correctiveAction: Document unresolved risks and follow-up actions, or mark not applicable.

rules.label: Reassessment date scheduled
rules.failReason: Reassessment date has not been scheduled.
rules.correctiveAction: Schedule and record the reassessment date. Default interval is 6 months.

rules.label: Reassessment triggers identified
rules.failReason: Conditions requiring reassessment have not been identified.
rules.correctiveAction: Identify triggers such as infrastructure, staging, C2, construction, or seasonal change.

rules.label: Open certificate items reviewed
rules.failReason: Open certificate items have not been reviewed with the RPIC.
rules.correctiveAction: Review with the RPIC: the undefined term 'open air assemblies of persons' (SP 13(c), 14(a), 15(a)) and the 0.88 lb boundary that appears in both SP 13/14 and SP 15.

rules.label: Site risk not high
rules.failReason: Overall site risk is marked high.
rules.correctiveAction: Reduce risk through mitigation or escalate for Program Manager review.

rules.label: Property boundaries photo evidence
rules.failReason: Property boundaries photo evidence is missing.
rules.correctiveAction: Add property boundaries photo evidence.

rules.label: Access control photo evidence
rules.failReason: Access control photo evidence is missing.
rules.correctiveAction: Add access control photo evidence.

rules.label: Shielding features photo evidence
rules.failReason: Shielding features photo evidence is missing.
rules.correctiveAction: Add shielding features photo evidence.

rules.label: Launch zone photo evidence
rules.failReason: Launch zone photo evidence is missing.
rules.correctiveAction: Add launch zone photo evidence.

rules.label: Emergency landing zone photo evidence
rules.failReason: Emergency landing zone photo evidence is missing.
rules.correctiveAction: Add emergency landing zone photo evidence.

rules.label: Annotated site image photo evidence
rules.failReason: Annotated site image photo evidence is missing.
rules.correctiveAction: Add annotated site image photo evidence.

rules.failReason: Annotated site map photo evidence is missing.

conditions.text: Operate only within the assessed site, documented route, mapped geofence, and approved operational volume (SP 11(d), SP 18(c), SP 32).
The RPIC must verify airspace status, NOTAMs, TFRs, weather, aircraft status, crew readiness, and site conditions before each operational period.
C2 link health, telemetry continuity, command response, and video stability must be confirmed before launch and monitored during flight (SP 27).
Lost link, RTH, emergency descent, and recovery procedures must remain inside the assessed containment area (SP 18(d), SP 22).
Emergency landing and recovery areas documented in this assessment must remain available and free of new hazards.
Stop operations and reassess if ground risk exposure, access control, RF or C2 conditions, obstacles, construction, route geometry, or shielding conditions materially change.
The site must be reassessed no later than the recorded reassessment date.

Airspace: SP 16 authorizes operations only at or below the published UASFM grid altitude. Any operation above the grid requires a separate ATC authorization; LAANC may not be used for waivered operations. Class G requires no authorization.

Shielded operations (SP 11): 200 ft AGL, or up to 100 ft above an obstruction within a 100 ft radius of the aircraft, never above 400 ft AGL. The UASFM grid height takes precedence where one applies. No VO or DAA is required by the certificate for shielded operations.
Non-shielded operations (SP 12): 400 ft AGL with active DAA under observation or with VO(s) continuously observing a 2 SM radius. With neither, the flight is not conducted under this waiver.
DAA coverage is compromised at this site. Non-shielded operations are limited to 200 ft AGL (SP 12(b)).

Visual Observers must be positioned to identify non-participating aircraft before they enter the operational area and to give the RPIC sufficient notice to remain well clear, with continuous full-duplex hands-free voice and a reliable backup. Operations cease if voice is lost (SP 12(c)(d)(e), SP 21(c)).

Operations over non-participants on the SP 13 pathway (over 0.88 lb, no PRS): the site stays restricted to the general public, every person in the operational area is site-related, equipped with PPE and notified, overflight is transitory only, routes avoid people and traffic areas, and the aircraft does not exceed 8.8 lb.

Operations over non-participants on the SP 14 pathway (over 0.88 lb, PRS): PRS operational and ASTM F3322-18 compliant, verified free of known defects within the previous 7 calendar days, unmodified and repacked by the manufacturer after any deployment, aircraft never below the PRS minimum deployment height, overflight transitory only, aircraft does not exceed 10 lb.

Operations over non-participants on the SP 15 pathway (0.88 lb or less including all attachments): rotating component shielding fitted, no sustained overflight including any payload delivery portion of flight.
Operations over open-air assemblies of persons are prohibited on every pathway. If an assembly forms inside the operational area, cease overflight.
Overflight of moving vehicles must be transitory. Loitering, hovering, and continuous or sequential overflight are prohibited.
SP 16 operations: a NOTAM must be filed no more than 72 and no less than 24 hours before operating, and verified issued before flight. Altitude is capped at the UASFM grid height.

Multi-aircraft operations are limited to six aircraft of the make/model and Flight Management System specified in the waiver application, each with an independent flight termination system verified with geofencing before every flight (SP 17).

Dock operations require the dock evaluation under SP 25(b)(iv): the RPIC must be able to determine the aircraft is safe for flight, clear the immediate flight area, and assess weather at the dock from the remote location.
Tactical deployment requires ground personnel to verify launch surface, clearances, communications, and local ground risk before launch.
One or more route segments are designated Yellow. The recorded operating restriction for each applies for the duration of operations at this site.
Medium risk site mitigations must be briefed, documented, and verified by the RPIC before each flight.
Any aircraft that undergoes maintenance completes a logged functional test flight under standard Part 107 before returning to waivered operations (SP 30(c)).

interpretations.issue: Captioned 'using VO(s) and or DAA'. Sub-provisions (b) and (c) are alternatives; no configuration without either is described.
interpretations.handling: EP treats a non-shielded profile with neither DAA nor VO(s) as outside the waiver: fly it under standard Part 107 VLOS, or reclassify as SP 11 shielded. Shielded operations carry no VO or DAA requirement on the face of the certificate.

interpretations.issue: SP 13 and SP 14 are captioned 'sUA => 0.88 lbs' and SP 15 'sUA <= 0.88lbs'. An aircraft weighing exactly 0.88 lb falls under both captions.
interpretations.handling: EP applies SP 15 at exactly 0.88 lb (the pathway written for that weight, including all attachments) and SP 13 or SP 14 above it. Written FAA clarification recommended; the boundary is not to be used to select the less restrictive pathway.

interpretations.issue: 'Open air assemblies of persons' is undefined in the certificate. The coordination pathway of the superseded certificate (old SP 29) no longer exists.
interpretations.handling: EP treats the term at its plain meaning: any gathering of persons in the open. Overflight is prohibited on every pathway. Written FAA clarification recommended.

interpretations.issue: The superseded certificate stated items this certificate does not: pre-flight hazard checklist with 1 SM low-level traffic, pedestrian and vehicle traffic, and highest obstacle (old SP 31); RTH 5 second trigger and altitude (old SP 32); illumination or daytime assessment (old SP 38); simulation testing (old SP 41); non-participant notification and participant vests (old SP 18(f)(g)).
interpretations.handling: Retained in this matrix as EP practice, labelled 'EP practice' in the provision column, with the same severity they carried in matrix v2.4. Program Manager decides whether to keep, downgrade, or drop each.
